goal_checks.notes: 0007_revoke_anon_execute.sql revokes EXECUTE on all public-schema functions from PUBLIC and anon, grants it to authenticated, and sets the same default for future functions. The front door is closed for an unauthenticated caller while the policy helpers stay callable by authenticated (proven by g17 in the live suite).

0008_team_profile_names.sql adds a permissive SELECT policy on profiles using a self-join on team_members: a member reads anyone who shares a team; outsiders and other teams stay invisible. The existing own-profile policy is untouched (permissive policies OR).

rls.sql gained a tb_test.anon() helper and the g17/g18 checks in the harness's style; they are part of the live RLS suite. The suite needs the local stack, so its run is the task's recorded follow-up.
README §6's housekeeping list and the task review's §3.5 are updated to mark the two items done, and this task is recorded on the progress board.

issues_found: The live RLS run is deferred: it needs Docker and the local stack. The checks are written but unexecuted here; this is recorded, not claimed as passing.
Default privileges cover future functions; a later migration that creates a function and grants it to anon explicitly would still need review.
The profiles policy increases read visibility within a team only; if the product ever wants names hidden between members, this is the policy to revisit.
